acceptance_basis: owner-defined (2026-11-07): accuracy >= 75 % and significantly better than reusing the latest survey (Brier CI < 0) at each served lead
statistical_reliability: Validated on the same 72 provincial forecasts per lead as E168/E184 (reused across many experiments); about 80 % pooled over Leads 1-3 after a winner's-curse adjustment (docs/e196/RELIABILITY.md); independent confirmation pending on the sealed ENNS 2022 forecasts. Synthetic rows are training data only.

synthetic_training.generator: jitter 0.5 SD, boundary focus, classes balanced

lagged_averaging.lead_1: mean of this issue's Lead 1 and issue 2026-Q3's Lead 2 (same target)
